projects.title: Better Google Maps
projects.description: This Geographic Information System (GIS) software displays maps and relevant information, such as street names, points of interest, and subway lines, for various major cities around the world. The project was developed in C++ and utilizes APIs based on Open Street Map (OSM) data. For graphics, it employs the EZGL Graphics Library, supplemented by GTK and Glade. The software features pathfinding capabilities using Dijkstra and A* Search Algorithms, along with a precise directions window to facilitate easy travel. Additionally, it incorporates a solution for the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) using Multi-Start and 2-opt approaches, and leverages multi-threading to enhance efficiency.

projects.title: BlueSurf
projects.description: A dynamic web application designed for University of Toronto students, enabling efficient event discovery straightforward event creation, fostering a connected campus community. Dynamic searching, filtering and sorting. Post creation and management. Apple and Google Calendar integrations.
